scope: Owner-reviewed expansion batch 03: 131 new spellings approved for revision 18; nine rejected spellings excluded from all roles. Original review IDs and draft examples retained.
sourceAttribution: Wiktionary contributors, fixed-revision source links per entry, concise adapted glosses under CC BY-SA 4.0. Supplemental Georgian explanatory-dictionary links verify selected senses; their text is not reproduced. See content/dictionaries/README.md.
selection: Individually selected noun/adjective senses; each candidate has a verified connected five-answer draft with four already approved words, seven tiles, at least two five/six-letter answers, valid crossings, density and phone size. Prioritize candidates with existing unused approved companions.
limitations: Owner review complete: 131 additions approved and nine spellings rejected. Campaign use remains subject to all rules.
Individual board feasibility does not guarantee whole-campaign placement or reduced repetition under the 75-level gap, unique-wheel and pacing rules.
The board search is bounded; unselected candidates are not declared impossible.
Frequency ranks were supporting discovery evidence only; no native-speaker review is claimed.
